name: Honey
description:
Sweet-smelling honey. If you spread some where a
Pokémon lives, that Pokémon will return home.

name: Sturdy stick
description:
A branch that fell off a tree somewhere. Perfect for
making various toys and everyday items.

name: Stone
description:
Just a normal stone you can find anywhere. It can
be used as a material for a lot of different things.

name: Leaf
description:
A lush, vivid green leaf that you can obtain by cutting
trees and grass.

name: Small log
description:
These can be processed into lumber, but they can
also be used as is for certain crafting projects.

name: Vine rope
description:
Obtained by cutting vines, which grow in caves and
high-altitude areas.

name: Glowing mushrooms
description:
Bioluminescent mushrooms. You can’t eat them, but
they’d probably make great lights!

name: Twine
description:
Obtained by destroying textile garbage. Bug-type
Pokémon can also produce it.

name: Sea glass fragments
description:
Pieces of glass that have been polished and buffed by
ocean waves. They’re used to make glass objects.

name: Seashell
description:
A common seashell found on sandy beaches. This is
useful material for building houses.

name: Nonburnable garbage
description:
Trash discarded here and there. Apparently some
Pokémon are big fans of garbage.

name: Squishy clay
description:
A soft, malleable crafting material used for all sorts of
things. It can also be fired and hardened into bricks!

name: Fluff
description:
An irresistibly soft tuft of fluff. Pokémon with the
Litter specialty might scatter this.

name: Wastepaper
description:
These look tough to craft with in their current state.
Try recycling them into regular paper!

name: Copper ore
description:
Raw mineral copper. When processed into ingots, it
can be used as a crafting material.

name: Iron ore
description:
Metal that can be obtained from iron deposits. It can
also be found among metal debris.

name: Gold ore
description:
Metal extracted from gold deposits. It glitters with a
luxurious sheen.

name: Pokémetal fragment
description:
Colorful, sparkling metal extracted from Pokémetal
deposits.

name: Rare Pokémetal fragment
description:
This can sometimes be found in Pokémetal deposits.
If you find one, consider yourself extremely lucky!

name: Crystal fragment
description:
A piece of broken crystal. It’s transparent, so you can
see right through it.

name: Lumber
description:
Wood that’s been cut so it’s easy to use. If you’re
making something out of wood, this is for you!

name: Brick
description:
Bricks made by baking clay. They’re perfect for
making buildings, roads, and other structures.

name: Copper ingot
description:
Copper that has been processed in a smelting
furnace. It kinda looks like chocolate...

name: Iron ingot
description:
Iron that has been processed in a smelting furnace.
It’s really hard and super heavy.

name: Gold ingot
description:
Gold that has been processed in a smelting furnace.
Just looking at it makes you feel fancy.

name: Pokémetal
description:
Made from smelted Pokémetal fragments, these can
be used to make various items.

name: Rare Pokémetal
description:
Made from smelted rare Pokémetal fragments, these
can be used to make various items.

name: Glass
description:
You can make glass by melting sand or sandstone in a
furnace, or obtain it by smashing broken windows.

name: Concrete
description:
Made from a thick liquid that has hardened. This stuff
is solid and super sturdy.

name: Paper
description: Pristine white paper made from recycled wastepaper.

name: Tinkagear
description:
A cool gear processed by Tinkaton. You can sense
their dedication to the craft contained within it.

name: Strange strings
description:
These strings make a cool sound when plucked.
Use them to make guitars and bass guitars.

name: Armor fragment
description:
A piece of shattered armor. Gather all the shards to
create armor brimming with emotions.

name: Stardust
description:
Sand that can be processed into Star Pieces. It can be
found on Dream Islands.

name: Red paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Blue paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Green paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Yellow paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Pink paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Cyan paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: White paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Black paint
description:
Colorful paint made from crushed berries.
A must-have when painting.

name: Cotton spores
description: Small, white tufts of cotton. Bring them to Hoppip!

name: Red crystal fragment
description: A piece of broken red crystal. Bring it to Sableye!

name: Watermelon
description:
A big, round watermelon. Get a Pokémon to cut it
into slices!

name: Grubby pearl
description:
Give this to a Pokémon with the Scrub specialty to
have them clean off the dirt.

name: Shiny pearl
description:
A shiny, pristine pearl. You might be able to use it to
make furniture or other things.

name: Leppa Berry
description:
A berry with a rather unremarkable flavor.
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Chesto Berry
description:
A rock-hard berry with a dry flavor. Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Rawst Berry
description:
The longer and more curled the leaves are, the more
bitter this berry tastes. Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Aspear Berry
description:
This berry has a distinctively sharp sour taste.
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Pecha Berry
description:
A sweet, delicious berry. Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Lum Berry
description:
A berry that has a well-balanced flavor. Restores some
PP when eaten.

name: Bean
description:
Small beans that are jam-packed with nutrients.
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Tomato
description:
A round, tasty-looking tomato. Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Wheat
description:
They’re actually edible raw! Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Potato
description:
A delicious potato—even with the skin still on!
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Fresh carrot
description:
You can harvest these spicy carrots by pulling up on
their leaves. Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Seaweed
description:
Seaweed that has washed ashore. Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Cave mushrooms
description:
Mushrooms that grow in damp places, such as caves
or under shady trees. Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Simple salad
description:
An ordinary salad made with leaves. Powers up
Leafage when eaten.

name: Leppa salad
description:
A sweet salad made with Leppa Berries. Powers up
Leafage when eaten.

name: Seaweed salad
description:
A bitter-tasting salad made with seaweed. Powers up
Leafage when eaten.

name: Shredded salad
description:
A sour salad made with finely chopped leaves.
Powers up Leafage when eaten.

name: Crushed-berry salad
description:
A salad with a dry flavor, made with crushed Chesto
Berries. Powers up Leafage when eaten.

name: Crouton salad
description:
A spicy salad with a delightfully crunchy texture.
Powers up Leafage when eaten.

name: Simple soup
description:
An ordinary soup made with Fresh Water. Powers up
Water Gun when eaten.

name: Seaweed soup
description:
A bitter-tasting soup made with seaweed. Powers up
Water Gun when eaten.

name: Mushroom soup
description:
A soup with a dry flavor made with mushroom broth.
Powers up Water Gun when eaten.

name: Electrifying soup
description:
A shockingly spicy soup. Powers up Water Gun
when eaten.

name: Healthy soup
description:
A spicy soup with an aromatic bean flavor. Powers up
Water Gun when eaten!

name: Flavorful soup
description:
A sour soup bursting with flavor. Powers up
Water Gun when eaten.

name: Simple bread
description: Ordinary wheat bread. Powers up Cut when eaten.

name: Leppa bread
description:
Sour-tasting bread made with Leppa Berry jam.
Powers up Cut when eaten.

name: Carrot bread
description:
Spicy bread with an intense carrot flavor. Powers up
Cut when eaten.

name: Recycled bread
description:
Bitter-tasting bread made by reusing other bread.
Powers up Cut when eaten.

name: Fluffy bread
description:
Sweet bread made with Pecha Berries. Powers up Cut
when eaten.

name: Bread bowl
description:
Spicy bread that’s delicious even when burnt.
Powers up Cut when eaten.

name: Simple hamburger steak
description:
An ordinary hamburger steak, made with beans.
Powers up Rock Smash when eaten.

name: Mushroom hamburger steak
description:
A hamburger steak with an intensely dry, mushroomy
flavor. Powers up Rock Smash when eaten.

name: Tomato hamburger steak
description:
A hamburger steak that brings out the sour flavor of
its ingredients. Powers up Rock Smash when eaten.

name: Potato hamburger steak
description:
A satisfyingly sweet hamburger steak. Powers up
Rock Smash a lot when eaten!

name: Bitter hamburger steak
description:
A bitter-tasting hamburger steak topped with leaves.
Powers up Rock Smash when eaten.

name: Vibrant hamburger steak
description:
A hamburger steak made with lots of ingredients.
Powers up Rock Smash a lot when eaten!

name: Bruised berry
description: A bruised berry you got from Chef Dente. Restores a bit of PP when eaten.

name: Common Candy
description:
A piece of candy you got from Chef Dente.
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Rare Candy
description:
A Rare Candy you got from Chef Dente.
Restores a lot of PP when eaten.

name: Curry and rice
description: An absolutely essential meal for any party. Enjoy some tasty food alongside other Pokémon!

name: Fresh Water
description:
Delicious water that’s perfect for making soup.
Drink some and spit it out to make things wet.

name: Soda Pop
description:
Fizzy, sparkling soda. If you take a sip and spit it out,
it becomes seawater!

name: Moomoo Milk coffee
description:
Milky coffee with a comfortingly sweet taste. If you
take a sip and spit it out, it becomes muddy water!

name: Roserade Tea
description:
Tea with a delicate, elegant aroma. If you take a sip
and spit it out, it becomes a hot spring!

name: Chili Sauce
description:
Sauce with an enticingly spicy flavor. If you take a sip
and spit it out, it becomes lava!

name: Watermelon slice
description:
A sweet slice of watermelon. Restores some PP
when eaten.

name: Sea grapes
description:
A type of faintly bitter seaweed found in the ocean.
Restores some PP when eaten.

name: Popping salad
description: A bitter salad made with plenty of sea grapes. Powers up Leafage when eaten.

name: Popping soup
description: A bitter soup that smells of the sea. Powers up Water Gun when eaten.

name: Watermelon bread
description: Sweet bread made with watermelon. Powers up Cut when eaten.

name: Explosive hamburger steak
description:
A hamburger steak so spicy you’ll leap out of your
seat. Powers up Rock Smash a lot when eaten!

name: Watermelon smoothie
description: A smoothie made with watermelon. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Sea grape smoothie
description:
A dry-tasting smoothie with a springy, popping
texture. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Leppa smoothie
description: A sweet smoothie made with Leppa Berries. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Red-hot smoothie
description: A smoothie so spicy it nearly burns your tongue. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Refreshing soda smoothie
description: A sour, highly carbonated smoothie. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Coffee parfait smoothie
description: A bitter smoothie with a rich depth of flavor. Drink one to power up Surf.

name: Storage box
description:
A convenient box you can store items in. It’s made of
wood and easy to move things in and out of.

name: Wall storage box
description:
It may be small, but it can store lots of stuff.
Try mounting it on a wall.

name: Big storage box
description:
Roughly three times bigger than your standard
storage box. You can put a lot of things inside.

name: Plain chest
description:
A chest with a simple design. It can be used to
store items.

name: Office cabinet
description:
Compact furniture that’s surprisingly spacious.
Open the sliding door to put items inside.

name: Gaming fridge
description: A chest that's slightly cold to the touch. Ice Pokémon will probably enjoy this.

name: Poké Ball chest
description:
This looks like a giant Poké Ball. It opens wide for you
to store things inside.

name: Berry case
description:
At a glance, this looks just like a glossy Cheri Berry.
It opens wide for you to store things inside.

name: Antique chest
description:
Its four curvy legs are adorable. Try putting lots of
different things in the drawer!

name: Plain closet
description:
Open the curtains and store your stuff! You don’t
actually need the hangers—but they’re there anyway!

name: Office locker
description:
A large locker that can even hold clothing. Try storing
lots of different things in it!

name: Antique closet
description: A large, bulky closet. Try storing different things in it!

name: Office shelf
description:
This is jam-packed with so many files that it can’t
hold anything else...

name: Polygonal shelf
description:
A stylish, eye-catching shelf. Looks hard to use but
still functions as a shelf just fine.

name: Straw table
description:
“Table” may be an overly generous description of this
big slab of stone atop a pile of hay.

name: Log table
description:
With just some cutting and sanding, you can turn logs
into a proper table.

name: Side table
description:
A side table with a refreshing appearance. It’d be
perfect next to a beach chair.

name: Garden table
description:
A stylish table that would look nice with a garden
chair or two.

name: Wooden table
description:
You only need lumber to make this. Despite its small
size, it’s still a splendid table.

name: Counter
description:
Line up these counters to make them longer. You can
also rotate a few to make some nice corners.

name: Wall-mounted table
description:
A superb table that can fit snugly in a corner. A row
of them would also make a great countertop.

name: Pokémon Center counter
description:
Line these up to make a Pokémon Center countertop.
They have a simple, clean design.

name: Kitchen table
description:
A glossy table that protects against grime. It would
look great placed near a sink and stove.

name: Push cart
description:
A table-height cart. Try putting stuff on top of it,
like food!

name: Exhibition stand
description:
You can place these side by side to adjust the size.
Try displaying lots of different things on top!

name: Mysterious pedestal
description: Looks like it originally had something on top of it...

name: Plain stand
description:
This low table has a simple design and is perfect for
displaying items.

name: Iron stand
description:
An impressively sturdy iron stand. Effortlessly supports
even heavy items.

name: Food counter
description:
A counter that is perfect for putting out food
at parties.

name: Plain table
description:
This simple table can be placed just about anywhere.
Try putting different things on it!

name: Antique table
description:
Its lumpy legs are cute. You can make a large table by
arranging several of these together.

name: Industrial desk
description:
A desk with a beautiful wood grain texture. This
would even look great outside the house.

name: Iron table
description:
Iron-crafted with a simple design. This would work
well in any sleekly stylish room.

name: Office desk
description:
A desk often used in offices. The pull-out drawer is
locked and won’t open.

name: Study desk
description:
Just looking at this desk feels like it will somehow
make you smarter.

name: Cute table
description:
A table with cute lace and frills. It somehow reminds
you of Fairy types.

name: Iron rack
description:
Decorate your space by putting your favorite things
on these stackable shelves!

name: Resort table
description:
This table is made of resilient material and perfectly
safe to keep outside, even in rain or a squall.

name: Chic table
description:
A table that would look right at home in a fancy
restaurant. Perfect for a decadent dinner.

name: Pop art table
description: A shiny, round table. It’s as smooth as a Porygon2!

name: Poké Ball table
description:
A round table that looks like a Poké Ball. It’s large
enough to carry lots of stuff.

name: Berry table
description:
A large Aspear Berry table. It looks real enough to
make you want to bite into it.

name: Stone table
description: A table made from stones. It’s as hard as an Onix!

name: Luxury table
description:
An extravagant marble table. Setting one down brings
elegance to any room.

name: Office table
description:
You can see through the glass surface. If you drop
anything underneath it, you’ll notice right away!

name: Avalugg table
description:
A solid table with cracks in it. It looks just like a
resting Avalugg.

name: Straw stool
description:
This is the perfect size for small Pokémon to take
a seat!

name: Berry chair
description:
When placed on the ground, it looks just like a buried
Leppa Berry. The stem and leaves are a backrest.

name: Simple cushion
description:
A simple, practical cushion. It’s filled with cotton and
provides a soft seat.

name: Log chair
description:
You can sit on this log to take a quick breather.
Other Pokémon might stop by to take a break too.

name: Plain stool
description:
A stool with a simple design. Small Pokémon can use
this as a seat.

name: Resort stool
description:
While this stool looks stiff, the cotton padding inside
makes it surprisingly soft.

name: Stylish stool
description: A small, round stool with a stylish three-color cushion.

name: Industrial chair
description:
A perfectly round chair that can easily fit anywhere.
Surprisingly sturdy, thanks to its iron legs.

name: Waterproof seat
description:
A smooth waterproof chair. Place it near a bathtub
or shower.

name: Wooden stool
description:
It’s a little chipped but surprisingly sturdy. Even if a
Pokémon sits on it, it won’t break. Probably.

name: Iron chair
description:
Though small, this seat is very sturdy. It doesn’t look
like it would break easily.

name: Public seat
description:
A simple chair without a backrest. Try arranging a
bunch of ’em together!

name: Soft seat
description:
A cushioned seat that’s soft and fluffy—perfect for
waiting rooms, relaxation spaces, and the like!

name: Box sofa
description:
A small square sofa. Line up several of them to make
a wide chic sofa.

name: Plain chair
description:
This chair is just the right height for eating meals in
the dining room.

name: Resort chair
description:
A chair perfect for relaxing. Kick back on this to taste
a bit of the resort life.

name: Chic chair
description:
A luxurious lounge chair. Sitting on its soft cushions is
absolutely beyond compare!

name: Fancy chair
description:
A high-class chair with a real dignified feel to it.
Just sitting here will make you feel important.

name: Antique chair
description:
A chair with a charming retro design. Its cushions are
soft and fluffy.

name: Spectator chair
description:
Audience seats like those found at concert halls or
stadiums. Try arranging a bunch of ’em in a row!

name: Luxury chair
description:
A classy-looking seat with a gemstone embedded
in it. Just sitting on it makes you feel rich.

name: Garden chair
description:
A chair that would be perfect in a nice garden. Take a
seat and enjoy an elegant afternoon.

name: Folding chair
description:
A foldable chair that’s simple and easy to carry.
Set these up at event venues or similar spaces!

name: Office chair
description:
With a gentle curve to support the body, this chair
was designed to help you sit longer without tiring.

name: Cute chair
description: The ruffle skirt is exceptionally cute and lovely.

name: Pop art chair
description: A chair with a soft design and rounded corners. The colors of the backrest and cushion can be changed!

name: Gaming chair
description: With its large backrest and cushions, you could sit comfortably in this chair for a long time.

name: Wooden bench
description:
A long bench that’s perfect for taking a break.
Pokémon might sit next to each other here.

name: Stone bench
description:
A wide, rock-solid seat. This would make a great
park bench.

name: Plain sofa
description:
If you see small Pokémon on this sofa, try sitting down
next to them!

name: Resort sofa
description:
Sitting on this makes you feel like you’re in the
tropics! Feel free to just laze the day away...

name: Chic sofa
description:
A luxurious high-class sofa. It looks exactly like the
ones on the S.S. Anne.

name: Antique sofa
description: A retro sofa with Poké Ball designs here and there.

name: Iron bench
description:
A seat made of solid, hardened iron. It’s sturdy
enough to support even the heaviest Pokémon.

name: Industrial bench
description:
A simple bench made of wood and iron. The kind
you’d expect to find at parks and walking paths.

name: Luxury sofa
description: This sofa is sooo fluffy. It’s like sitting on a cloud.

name: Garden bench
description:
A stylish bench with a vine pattern. Put one down to
instantly add some flair to an area.

name: Cute sofa
description:
A cute, slightly elegant sofa. The backrest is shaped
like a Pokémon’s wings.

name: Pop art sofa
description: A soft-looking sofa with cute, rounded edges.

name: Poké Ball sofa
description:
Experience sitting inside an open Poké Ball!
Seats two comfortably.

name: Pikachu sofa
description:
Pikachu’s face is front and center. On the back, you
can find a little tail sticking out.

name: Log bed
description:
A bed made from small logs. You’ll sleep soundly
enveloped by a woodsy aroma.

name: Mini plain bed
description: A small, plain bed. Great for solo sleepers!

name: Resort bed
description:
A refreshingly cool bed made of woven vines. Lying
down on this makes you feel like you’re at a resort.

name: Iron bed
description:
A slightly narrow bed. It’s sturdy enough for a good
night’s sleep!

name: Deck chair
description:
Lean this chair back and relax for a bit. It looks great
for sunbathing.

name: Beach chair
description:
Lean back and relax in this chair. It pairs perfectly
with a beach parasol.

name: Straw bed
description:
It’s a little itchy, but that doesn’t bother Pokémon.
They’ll snooze away just fine on this.

name: Pop art bed
description:
Lying on this bed feels like being inside of a pod.
It’s soft, fluffy, and easy to sleep on.

name: Poké Ball bed
description:
A big bed. Even large Pokémon could sprawl out
on it.

name: Berry bed
description: A large Pecha Berry-themed bed. Its springy texture provides ultimate comfort at bedtime.

name: Wooden bed
description:
This bed gives any room a mountain lodge aesthetic.
You’ll sleep soundly surrounded by the woodsy scent.

name: Plain bed
description:
A bed with a simple design. It looks like it would
mesh with a variety of rooms.

name: Resort hammock
description:
The breeze feels so nice when you’re lying on this
hammock. It’s perfect for dozing off!

name: Guest-room bed
description:
A bed with a rather high-class vibe. It looks like it
belongs on a luxury ship or in a fancy hotel.

name: Antique bed
description:
This bed has a relaxing, nostalgic atmosphere.
The blanket is smooth to the touch.

name: Industrial bed
description:
A nice, wide bed that works in any type of room.
Even a large Pokémon could sleep in it.

name: Luxury bed
description:
An extravagantly crafted bed. It somehow reminds
you of a Luxury Ball!

name: Cute bed
description:
You’ll feel like royalty sleeping on this cute
canopy bed.

name: Gaming bed
description:
A cool, stylish bed. Flip on the power switch to get a
cyberspace vibe going.

name: Naptime bed
description:
Kick back right on top of Snorlax’s belly. It feels so
comfy you could snooze through the whole day.

name: Wall mirror
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Large mirror
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Antique dresser
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Luxury dresser
description: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

name: Cute dresser
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Wiggly mirror
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Flower table
description:
A table with a flower-patterned tablecloth. It makes
any meal feel just like a picnic!

name: Flower cushion
description:
A cute flower-shaped cushion. It would look nice
on some grassy ground.

name: Camping chair
description: A simple seat that's perfect for resting on while camping or adventuring.

name: Sleeping bag
description:
A comfy sleeping bag with lots of soft, fluffy padding.
Even on cold days, you’ll feel warm and toasty inside!

name: Star closet
description:
A closet with many stars painted on it. Open the
doors and store your stuff inside!

name: Cloud table
description:
A colorful cloud table. It may look fluffy, but it’s
actually solid!

name: Starry-sky bed
description:
A bed covered in sparkling stars. Sleeping in it might
make you dream of flying through a starry sky.

name: Star-shaped dresser
description:
Look into the mirror to change your transformation
and perfect your look!

name: Portal pod
description: Anything you put into this mysterious machine can be retrieved from any of these machines.

name: Safe
description:
You can set a passcode for this safe. Keep things in
here that you don’t want to lose!

name: Decorative Poké Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Big treasure chest
description:
A very large treasure chest. You can fit lots of
stuff inside!

name: Marine chest
description:
A stylish chest adorned with seashells and pearls.
Try storing lots of different things in it!

name: Marine closet
description: A closet with stylish handles. Try storing items in it!

name: Marine table
description:
Containing coral, seashells, and sea glass, this vibrant
table is the optimal oceanside adornment.

name: Ornate stand
description:
A stand with a stylish wave pattern. It’s big, so you
can put a lot of stuff on it.

name: Ornate table
description:
A table with an ornate pattern carved into it. Place it
anywhere to make a space more glamorous.

name: Seashell seat
description:
Open the Clamperl-like shell and have a seat on the
plush cushion inside.

name: Marine chair
description:
A beautiful seat that looks just like coral. It’s a little
hard but not uncomfortable to sit on.

name: Ornate chair
description:
A sturdy chair with golden accents. Sitting in it will
make you feel like a big shot.

name: Marine sofa
description:
The seat inside the seashell is soft. The pristine pearls
give it a very prim appearance.

name: Ornate bed
description:
A bed featuring an intriguing pattern. On closer
inspection, the pattern looks like Poké Balls.

name: Cushion bed
description:
A huge cushion that can be used as a bed. Even large
Pokémon can lie down and stretch out on this.

name: Marine dresser
description: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

name: Wooden plate
description:
If you put some food on this plate, Pokémon might
stop by to eat.

name: Plate
description:
Dishware made from fired clay. A Pokémon might eat
food served on it.

name: Offering dish
description:
Try placing food on this platter as an offering
to Mosslax!

name: Party platter
description:
A plate for serving party food. No sneaking a taste
before the party starts, though!

name: Picnic basket
description:
Try putting some food inside, and hungry Pokémon
might stop by for a bite!

name: Mug
description:
A simple, easy-to-use mug. You could change up the
colors, and it would still look great.

name: Tea set
description:
Enjoy an elegant teatime with this gorgeous set that
includes a teapot and teacups.

name: Table setting
description:
This cutlery immediately makes any table look like it
belongs in a high-class restaurant.

name: Paper party cups
description:
Paper cups that are easy to carry—perfect for hosting
a party!

name: Pizza
description: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

name: Fried potatoes
description:
Food loved by one of Eevee’s friends. Be sure to
prepare a table and chair too!

name: Soda float
description: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

name: Afternoon tea set
description:
Food loved by one of Eevee’s friends. Be sure to
prepare a table and chair too!

name: Chocolate cookies
description: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

name: Sandwiches
description: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

name: Shaved ice
description: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

name: Ribbon cake
description:
Food loved by one of Eevee’s friends. Be sure to
prepare a table and chair too!

name: Berry basket
description:
A basket packed with berries. Line up a few to make
your very own fruit stand!

name: Small vase
description:
A vase with a single cute flower inside. Put it
anywhere to add a splash of color to your life!

name: Leafy plant
description:
A plant with large, glossy leaves. It’s actually related
to the taro root!

name: Pitcher-plant pot
description:
A flower vase with a pink lip that resembles a
Pokémon’s mouth. It emanates a faintly sweet aroma.

name: Extravagant flowers
description:
With robust orange flowers in full bloom, using this
for decoration is sure to add some color to an area.

name: Tall potted plant
description:
A small, thin palm tree. It comes in a planter, so it
won’t make a mess even if it’s placed indoors.

name: Flat-leaf plant
description:
A plant with flat leaves that look like planks.
It’s actually a type of succulent!

name: Twisted potted plant
description:
A plant with a winding, twisted trunk. It doesn’t look
like it will get any bigger than it already is.

name: Munna bank
description:
An especially heavy money box. It feels like it’s full
of coins.

name: Small garbage can
description: A simple, colorful trash can, perfect for indoor use.

name: Pencil holder
description:
A pencil holder with lots of pencils in it. Try putting
this on top of a study desk!

name: Fancy pen
description:
A high-class ballpoint pen that exudes luxury. A very
important person would have used this.

name: Letter
description: A simple sealed letter. It has a Poké Ball stamp on it!

name: Notepad
description:
It’s full of important-looking notes, so there’s no
space to write anything else!

name: Book
description:
A thick hardcover book. The pages inside were
written in small print.

name: Open book
description:
A classic hardcover book. It’s probably got a lot of
difficult words inside.

name: Book pile
description:
A pile of upturned books with torn-out pages.
They look like they fell off a bookshelf.

name: Papers
description:
Lots of tiny words are written on the white pages
along with drawings of colorful shapes.

name: Newspaper
description:
Its pages are filled with small, tightly-packed letters.
What could be written here?

name: Photo frame
description:
You can put one of your photos in this frame and
place it on a table or stand.

name: Wall photo frame
description:
You can put one of your photos in this frame and
hang it on a wall.

name: Corkboard
description:
Choose one of your favorite photos to hang on
this corkboard!

name: CD rack
description: A rack with CDs on it. Sure to appeal to music lovers!

name: Magazine rack
description:
This stand has a great selection of weekly magazines
and photo books.

name: Mini bookcase
description:
A small bookcase packed with books. It’s tiny enough
to fit in tight spaces!

name: Bookcase
description:
Furniture with colorful books arranged on the shelves.
It looks like there’s room for even MORE books!

name: Stone fireplace
description:
A huge fireplace. Light this up to make a space feel
warm and cozy.

name: Dining cabinet
description:
A cupboard packed full of plates, cups—even a
tea set!

name: Modern sink
description:
A state-of-the-art sink that even has a drain. Turn the
handle to make water flow out.

name: Cooking stove
description:
A simple, stylish stove. Turn the dial, and flames will
shoot right out of it!

name: Microwave oven
description: This lights up when powered on, but it doesn't seem like it can actually heat anything...

name: Refrigerator
description:
It emits a slight chill, but it doesn’t seem like it can
actually keep anything cold...

name: Fan
description:
Power on this fan to make it swivel. Pokémon might
stop by to watch it move!

name: Air conditioner
description:
A state-of-the-art air conditioner. Press once for cold
air, or press twice for hot!

name: Printer
description: A large printer used by businesses. Perfect for an office or other workspaces!

name: Washing machine
description:
While this does make noise when powered on, it
doesn’t seem to actually wash clothes...

name: Toilet
description: Lift the cover and sit on the toilet for as long as you like.

name: Sink
description:
A stylish sink on a wooden stand. Turn on the faucet
to make water pour out.

name: Towel rack
description:
A simple wall rack with a towel hanging on it.
This would look great next to a sink.

name: Bathtime set
description:
Shampoo, towels, and a toy—everything you need to
make bath time a blast!

name: Cleaning supplies
description:
Detergent, a dust cloth, and a Mareep sponge are all
you need to become a cleaning master!

name: Shower
description:
A shower with a simple design. Place it next to a
bathtub to make your bathroom complete.

name: Bathtub
description:
A bathtub with a simple design. Fill it up with water to
enjoy a nice soak.

name: Bouncy blue bathtub
description: A bathtub that lets you experience waves and bubbles, even without a single drop of water inside.

name: Tablet
description:
A convenient, easy-to-carry computer. It’s got a hard
case, so no worries if you drop it!

name: Cell phone
description: A device carefully protected inside a hard case. It can't make calls, even when powered on.

name: Laptop
description:
A sleek, easy-to-carry laptop. Try displaying some
photos on the monitor!

name: Computer
description:
A computer that looks like it belongs in a laboratory.
Some notes have been stuck to it here and there.

name: Gaming PC
description: A PC rig that even includes a headset. The monitor can display photos when powered on.

name: Television
description:
A large television that can be easily viewed from far
away. It’s a flatscreen, so carrying it is easy-peasy.

name: Wall monitor
description:
A monitor that emits blue light when powered on.
Try displaying your photographs on it!

name: Arcade machine
description:
A game machine from a facility somewhere. It looks
brand-new, so it probably can still be turned on.

name: Alarm clock
description:
A loud noise rings out when you press this. Be careful!
You might accidentally wake someone up!

name: Toy blocks
description:
Stacking toys that are fun to play with. Discover all
the different combinations you can make!

name: Pinwheels
description:
Pokémon like to spin these round and round.
Wind-producing Pokémon especially like them!

name: Knitting supplies
description:
Tools for knitting hats, sweaters, and the like.
Pokémon are captivated by the round balls of yarn.

name: Game Boy system
description:
A very sturdy-looking game console. It’s old, but it
still seems to start up.

name: Humidifier
description:
A humidifier with a distinctive round shape. Turn it on
to increase the humidity level nearby.

name: Funky diffuser
description: The symbol on it looks dangerous, but it doesn't seem like this will actually spew out poison gas...

name: First aid kit
description:
A box filled with lots of medicines and supplies for
treating injuries.

name: Crystal ball
description:
A large crystal ball used for fortune-telling. Give it to
a Psychic-type Pokémon and see what happens...

name: Microscope
description:
A microscope often found in chemistry labs and
research institutions. Essential for experiments!

name: Science experiment
description:
Chemicals, testing equipment, and a clipboard...
OK! The experiment is ready to begin!

name: Jumbled cords
description:
These cords are all tangled up and cannot be
separated.

name: CD player
description:
A device that plays music. If you find a CD, try
putting it inside!

name: Tabletop mic
description:
A microphone like those used at recording studios or
public speeches. Try putting it on a desk!

name: Standing mic
description:
A microphone meant for the stage. Standing before it
makes you want to burst out in song.

name: Big drum
description:
A very impressive drum. Beat it to produce a loud,
invigorating da-da-DUM!

name: Cool electric guitar
description: A snazzy guitar strung with strange strings. Holding it would make you feel pretty amped...

name: Cool bass guitar
description:
A snazzy bass guitar strung with strange strings.
Holding it would make you feel pretty low-key...

name: Audio mixer
description:
Plug it in and switch on the screen. DJ Ditto in
the house!

name: Speaker
description:
Putting this next to a stage or an audio mixer ought
to create an electrifying atmosphere!

name: Gold Teeth
description: Their lustrous golden shine hasn't changed at all. Maybe someone dropped them long ago?

name: Repel
description: When you press the spray cap, a weird scent spritzes out and permeates the area.

name: Big Nugget
description:
It’s made of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam.
It seems like it was popular among enthusiasts.

name: Balloons
description:
Balloons of many vibrant colors. They sway back and
forth even in the most gentle of breezes.

name: Punching game
description:
Slug this machine real good with your fist, and it’ll tell
you how strong your punch is.

name: Boo-in-the-box
description: Open the box, and—BOING!—out pops the Gengar!

name: Wobbuffet wobbler
description:
An exceptionally durable Wobbuffet doll. It gets back
up no matter how many times you knock it over.

name: Step stool
description:
A step stool for reaching things in high places.
Try climbing on top of it!

name: Cardboard boxes
description:
Light cardboard boxes. It doesn’t look like they have
anything inside.

name: Whiteboard
description:
A whiteboard covered in writing and sticky notes that
looks like it belongs in a lab.

name: Control unit
description:
This has a bunch of switches, but it doesn’t look like
any of them do anything...

name: Auspicious Armor
description: Heavy armor recreated from armor fragments. Auspicious wishes live within it.

name: Malicious Armor
description:
Heavy armor recreated from armor fragments.
Malicious will lurks within it.

name: Clear Bell
description: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound. Ring it in an open space to call Ho-Oh.

name: Tidal Bell
description: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound. Ring it in an open space to call Lugia.

name: Ship’s wheel
description:
A wheel used to steer a ship. It spins round and round
when you touch it!

name: Mysterious statue
description:
Doesn’t seem like anyone knows exactly what this is
a statue of...

name: Fiery Magby statue
description:
If you place a switch nearby and activate it, Magby
will shoot fire out of their mouth! Fwooosh!

name: Gym emblem statue
description:
This stone statue makes you feel pumped up.
Would look great placed on a pedestal.

name: Spacesuit
description:
Clothing designed for living in outer space. Keeps the
wearer safe even in an airless environment.

name: Model space shuttle
description:
A realistic model that looks like it could blast off at
any second. Could it have been in some museum?

name: Spaceship
description:
A vehicle meant for traveling to outer space.
Hermetically sealed so air doesn’t escape.

name: Wall calendar
description:
A calendar that’s simple and easy to use. It meshes
well with pretty much any wall.

name: Wreath
description:
A simple wreath crafted from branches and leaves.
It’d look nice and elegant on a wall.

name: Decorative bookshelf
description:
A decorative shelf with colorful books on it.
Perfect for livening up any wall!

name: Decorative storage shelf
description:
A decorative shelf lined with ceramic bottles.
Attach it to a wall to liven up any space!

name: Decorative plant shelf
description:
A long vine droops from the potted plant on this
decorative shelf. Perfect for livening up any wall!

name: Antique clock
description:
This clock eternally ticks away the hours. It lets out a
loud bong at designated times.

name: Berry clock
description:
A clock that resembles an Oran Berry cross section.
Try mounting it on a wall!

name: Rowlet clock
description:
A wall clock shaped like a small house. Rowlet will
pop out to let you know what time it is!

name: Hanging banner
description: Cloth you might find on a department store's wall. Stack several to make 'em even longer!

name: Party bunting
description:
These make perfect party decorations. Hang a bunch
up to create a festive mood!

name: Vine wall decoration
description:
With just a few leaves and vine ropes, you can make
a stylish wall decoration.

name: Berry wall decoration
description:
The six swaying berries look incredibly tasty.
Alas, they’re inedible.

name: Hanging scroll
description:
A scroll with phenomenal brushwork. Hang it on a
wall to create a solemn atmosphere.

name: Ceiling fan
description:
Its blades spin round and round when powered on.
Great for when you want to circulate air!

name: Castform weather charm
description:
A reversible Castform doll. Rumor has it, when the
doll changes form, the weather changes too!

name: Eevee doll
description:
If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Pikachu doll
description:
If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Clefairy doll
description:
If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Arcanine doll

If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Dragonite doll

If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Ditto doll

If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Substitute doll
description:
If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Grubby letter
description: A yellowed letter, still sealed. It's got a postage stamp with a Poké Ball pattern on it.

name: Grubby notepad
description:
It looks like there’s some pretty important stuff
written on this, but it’s a little grimy.

name: Grubby book
description: A classical book with a grimy cover. There are probably lots of difficult words written inside.

name: Grubby papers
description:
Lots of tiny words are written on the yellowed pages
along with drawings of colorful shapes.

name: Grubby newspaper
description:
A newspaper with noticeable dirt and grime. It smells
like old paper...

name: Grubby tablet
description: A convenient, easy-to-carry device. Even though it's inside a hard case, the screen is cracked.

name: Grubby cell phone
description:
A device with a cracked screen. It can’t make any
calls, even when powered on.

name: Flowery table setting
description: A set of cute floral tableware. The placemat has a Jumpluff pattern!

name: Lunch box
description:
A lunch box packed with Pokémon-shaped food.
The perfect meal for a picnic lunch.

name: Hoppip water bottle
description:
This water bottle with a shoulder strap is perfect for
picnics! The Hoppip pattern is very cute.

name: Juice trio
description:
Bottles of colored juices. One of them is capped off
nicely with a flower-shaped lid.

name: Flower garland
description:
An adorable wall decoration made with a variety of
colorful flowers.

name: Flower backpack
description:
The big flower makes this backpack stand out! Looks
like it could hold everything you need for a picnic.

name: Inflatable Sudowoodo
description:
A balloon shaped like Sudowoodo. It stands up and
dances around just like a real Sudowoodo too!

name: Digital camera
description:
A single-lens digital camera. It’s so high-tech that it
looks tricky to use!

name: Jewel wall decoration
description:
Put these multi-colored jewels up on the wall to add
a little sparkle to your decor!

name: Adventure kit
description:
A sleeping bag, a hat, and a backpack stuffed full of
supplies. All you need for an adventure is right here!

name: Map and compass
description:
A map that indicates the location of treasure, and
a compass that shows you the way.

name: Treasure
description:
A pile of golden accessories and sparkling jewels.
Use this as decor to add an air of luxury.

name: Telescope
description:
A tool for seeing faraway things. Place it outside and
try taking a peek through it!

name: Moon clock
description:
A moon-shaped clock with a swaying pendulum.
What will happen when it strikes the hour?

name: Star wall decoration
description:
A set of twinkling stars. Decorate your wall with these
for a touch of cuteness!

name: Teaware set
description:
A stylish ceramic tea set. Looks perfect for
serving guests!

name: Decorative plates
description:
Decorative plates with cute patterns. They can add a
touch of flair to any shelf or counter.

name: Book stack
description:
A carefully balanced pile of books. You might be able
to stack them even higher!

name: Shop display case
description: A display case that looks like it belongs in a shop. The items inside are replicas.

name: Shop shelf
description: Retail shelves that look like they belong in a shop. They're stocked with useful adventuring items.

name: Shop fridge
description: A large fridge that looks like it belongs in a shop. Open the door to put things inside.

name: Ornate decorative shelf
description:
A beautifully opulent shelf on which valuable teaware
and a gorgeous pearl are displayed.

name: Bottled ship
description:
A model ship inside a glass bottle. These are actually
really difficult to make!

name: Sparkling jewelry
description:
Accessories made of gold, pearls, and jewels that
sparkle dazzlingly.

name: Metronome
description: A metronome that swings from left to right. Pokémon may sway along with it.

name: Music box
description:
A luxurious wooden music box. Wind it up and let the
music play!

name: Harp
description: A harp with a beautiful tone. Try plucking the strings to play it!

name: Decorative Great Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Decorative Heal Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Decorative Quick Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Decorative Dive Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Decorative Net Ball
description:
A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display
them all!

name: Decorative Lure Ball
description: A small Poké Ball replica. Collect and display them all!

name: Windup Inkay
description:
An Inkay toy that floats and bobs. Wind it up and let
the fun begin!

name: Toolbox
description:
A complete set of tools with everything you need:
screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench, and more!

name: Servers
description: A high-end computer. It glows brightly when powered on.

name: Decorative shop shelf
description:
A decorative shelf that looks like it belongs in a shop.
Perfect for livening up a wall.

name: Wall clock
description: A simple, round clock. Try hanging it up on a wall.

name: Wall plant
description:
Plants you can put up on the wall. They look like
flowers, but they’re actually leaves.

name: Wall-mounted tools
description: A well-organized assortment of tools. Hang this on the wall to add a trendy touch to any room.

name: Chimecho wind chime
description: A wind chime that looks just like Chimecho. It jingles when the wind blows.

name: Party ball
description: A large ball to be suspended from the ceiling. Try pulling the red and white string!

name: Running Shoes
description: A pair of very lightweight, comfortable sneakers. They still have that new-shoe shine to them.

name: Starmie doll
description:
If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly
over and whisk you away to a Dream Island!

name: Campfire
description:
A campfire made from gathered sticks. When
lit, it illuminates the area with a warm light.

name: Torch
description:
If you light this, it’ll burn slowly, filling the area with
bright light.

name: Slender candle
description:
Light this up to get a flickering bright-red flame.
It’s small enough to fit on a desk.

name: Eerie candle
description:
Fwoosh! This candle glows with a bluish flame
when lit. It’s small enough to fit on top of a desk.

name: Wall torch
description:
A simple light that looks appropriate even on rugged
surfaces such as caves and rock walls.

name: Firepit
description:
Set this ablaze to illuminate the surroundings with
bright light. Fwoosh!

name: Bonfire
description:
When the wood in the center catches fire, this
provides warmth and light to a large nearby area.

name: Sandbox
description:
Place this to set up a fun space for playing with sand.
Discover what you can create here!

name: Tire toy
description:
Tires used in parks as playground equipment. Put
them on the ground and have fun hopping over them!

name: Concrete pipe
description:
Link several of these to make the pipe as long as
you want! The inside is pitch black.

name: Punching bag
description:
Heavy and packed full of sand. Perfect for practicing
punches and kicks!

name: Slide
description:
An essential part of any playground. Its imposing size
leaves a real impression.

name: Vending machine
description:
Connect this to electricity to make it light up!
Looks like it still has some things inside for sale.

name: Wall-mounted flowers
description:
A planter filled with colorful flowers. Hang one on a
wall to create a vibrant space.

name: Chansey plant
description:
A tree that looks just like a Chansey! Looking at it
seems to fill you with a gentle energy.

name: Garden ornament
description:
This decoration looks like Maushold spending quality
time on a log.

name: Bike
description:
A cool bicycle that looks high-end. It sparkles as if
it’s brand-new.

name: Planter
description:
Plant some flower or vegetable seeds here, and raise
them until they’re fully grown.

name: Garden flowers
description:
A stylish flower pot with cute flowers in full bloom.
It would look great as a desk ornament.

name: Cart
description:
It has a large bed, so it looks like you can use it to
haul some pretty big stuff.

name: Perch
description:
A branch perch where bird Pokémon can rest.
Place a few, and you might get some visitors!

name: Wooden birdhouse
description:
A birdhouse filled with dry, soft grass. Bird Pokémon
would probably love lounging here.

name: Mailbox
description:
A box for receiving letters. It’d look really nice in
front of a house!

name: Weather vane
description:
A decoration that spins around and around in the
wind. Looks like a bird Pokémon perched on a post.

name: Gravestone
description:
A place where souls can rest in peace. Ghost-type
Pokémon might enjoy this.

name: Blank canvas
description:
A completely empty canvas. A Pokémon artist might
be inspired to paint something on it.

name: Painting (landscape)
description:
One of Smearguru’s passion projects. The contrast
between the forest and the mountain is beautiful.

name: Painting (portrait)
description: One of Smearguru's passion projects. The subject has been masterfully recreated, wobbliness and all.

name: Painting (still life)
description:
One of Smearguru’s passion projects. Each and every
object looks just like the real thing.

name: Cannon
description:
Put fireworks or a Pokémon with the Explode specialty
inside, light the fuse, and watch ’em fly!

name: Bell
description:
A golden, wall-mounted bell. When struck, it rings
with a pleasant sound.

name: Small stage
description:
Get on and start dancing! You can power on the lights
by hooking this up to electricity.

name: Hot-spring spout
description:
Place this next to a pool of hot water to create a
genuine hot-spring vibe.

name: Water basin
description:
Fill this with water so Pokémon can do some
watering for you!

name: Canoe
description:
A paddle, bucket, and rope is all you need for a
journey out to sea!

name: Inflatable boat
description:
Feels great whether you lie down on it like a bed, or
float it on the water like a boat.

name: Beach parasol
description:
Place one of these on the beach for protection from
scorching sunbeams.

name: Horsea fountain
description:
Installing this near water should raise the humidity
of its surroundings.

name: Fishing rod
description:
A must-have item for fishing up Pokémon. Set one by
the water and wait patiently for a bite!

name: Arrow sign
description:
An arrow-shaped sign. You could use it as a guidepost
at forked roads.

name: Menu board
description:
Specials are written on this board, but it doesn’t seem
like Pokémon can actually read them.

name: Sign
description:
A sign made out of wood. There’s an important
message written on it... Probably!

name: Signpost
description:
A sign that looks like it belongs at a bus stop. It could
serve as a guiding landmark in cities or on roads!

name: Information board
description:
A sign with information about the town written on it.
Nobody knows what town it’s for, though.

name: Raichu sign
description:
A sign depicting Raichu discharging electricity.
When powered up, the neon lighting glows brightly.

name: Photo cutout board
description:
Put your face through the hole to become Plusle
or Minun!

name: Worn wooden crate
description:
A sturdy but somewhat shabby box. Stack a bunch of
them to create a warehouse vibe.

name: Wooden crate
description:
You have absolutely no idea how to open this box...
But you can put stuff on top of it, at least!

name: Barrel
description:
It’s totally empty inside. You could put something on
top to make it look nice!

name: Garbage bags
description:
Trash bags found most anywhere. Certain Pokémon
find their odor irresistible.

name: Garbage bin
description:
This trash can is big enough that a Pokémon could
probably fit inside!

name: Recycling bin
description:
A bin for disposing of empty cans. It’s just big enough
for a Pokémon to fit inside.

name: Grubby rags
description: A piece of tattered cloth unsuitable for processing. Cut it up to obtain twine.

name: Traffic cone
description:
When lined up, the cones are connected by barrier
poles. Great for construction zones!

name: Sewer-hole cover
description:
A sewer-hole cover that opens like a door. It can
serve as an entrance if you put it on top of a hole.

name: Fire hydrant
description:
This device spews water for putting out fires, but
you’re not really sure how to use it...

name: Sandbags
description:
A cloth sack filled with dirt and sand. It’s pretty bulky
and looks heavy!

name: Excavation tools
description:
A sturdy-looking pickax and shovel. They’re wasted
on any Pokémon who can already dig, though.

name: Tires
description:
This tire stack looks like it could collapse at any
moment, but oddly enough it stays upright.

name: Metal drum
description:
A smooth, clean canister. It’s empty, so it’s actually
quite light.

name: Construction supplies
description:
Construction tools stored in a metal drum. Great for
factories or warehouses.

name: Iron pipes
description:
A pile of iron pipes that looks like it belongs at a
construction site.

name: Wheelbarrow
description:
A wheelbarrow carrying a large mound of dirt. A lot
of construction sites probably have these!

name: Large ventilation fan
description:
A huge, flat ventilation fan—the kind you’d find on
top of a building or a house.

name: Heat Rock
description:
A mysterious rock that radiates heat. Place it to raise
the temperature around it.

name: Icy Rock
description: A mysterious rock that radiates cold. Place it to lower the temperature around it.

name: Smooth Rock
description:
A mysterious rock that feels smooth. Place it to lower
the humidity of the surrounding area.

name: Damp Rock
description: A mysterious rock that feels damp. Place it to raise the humidity of the surrounding area.

name: Cloud cannon
description: Put fireworks or a Pokémon with the Explode specialty inside, light the fuse, and watch 'em fly!

name: Sandpile
description: A pile of sand with a big divot in the middle. It seems like a good hiding spot for Pokémon.

name: Sand toys
description:
Includes a bucket, a shovel, and a rake—perfect toys
to take to a sandbox or a beach.

name: Wavy-pattern planter
description:
Plant some flower or vegetable seeds here, and raise
them until they’re fully grown.

name: Gyarados fountain
description: A fountain that looks like Gyarados shooting water out of its mouth. Place it near a water source!

name: Primarina statue
description: A statue of Primarina using Surf. The white plaster really accentuates its beauty.

name: Arrow sign (left)
description: A signboard with an arrow painted on it. Put it on a wall to show the way!

name: Arrow sign (right)
description: A signboard with an arrow painted on it. Put it on a wall to show the way!

name: Hanging sign
description:
A stylish sign with a hanging panel. Try attaching this
to a wall!

name: Stone sign
description:
A stylish stone sign. Place it in front of a building to
give it a high-class feel.

name: Slim information board
description: A sign with information about the town written on it. Nobody knows what town it's for, though.

name: Cycle shop sign
description:
A sign that serves as a symbol of a bicycle shop.
Try putting this on a roof!

name: Supermarket sign
description:
A sign that serves as a symbol of a supermarket.
Try putting this on a roof!

name: Café sign
description: A sign that serves as a symbol of a café. Try putting this on a roof!

name: Restaurant sign
description: A sign that serves as a symbol of a restaurant. Try putting this on a roof!

name: Gift shop sign
description: A sign that serves as a symbol of a gift shop. Try putting this on a roof!

name: Ditto flag
description:
A flag that marks Ditto’s house. Place it on a house
you want to live in!

name: Workbench
description:
Try gathering lots of materials and making a variety of
different things here!

name: Community box
description:
Pokémon can deposit items they’ve stumbled upon
into this box or take items out to process them.

name: Frame
description:
A frame for hanging an item on a wall. Try putting
different things inside!

name: Cutting board
description:
Kitchen equipment for making salads. Grab some
ingredients and make something tasty!

name: Frying pan
description:
Kitchen equipment for making hamburger steak.
Put this on a stove or campfire.

name: Stylish frying pan
description:
Kitchen equipment for making hamburger steak.
Put this on a stove or campfire.

name: Cooking pot
description:
Kitchen equipment for making soup. Put this on a
stove or campfire.

name: Stylish cooking pot
description:
Kitchen equipment for making soup. Put this on a
stove or campfire.

name: Bread oven
description:
Kitchen equipment for baking bread. Have a
Pokémon light the fire for you!

name: Smelting furnace
description:
A furnace for processing ore into metals. Get a
Pokémon with the Burn specialty to help you out!

name: Metallic smelting furnace
description:
A high-performance metallic furnace that can quickly
process metals and other materials.

name: Concrete mixer
description:
A Pokémon with the Crush specialty can use this to
make concrete out of water and stone.

name: Railway track
description:
Lay down tracks to create a railway, then ride a
handcar to get where you’re going in a jiffy!

name: Crossing gate
description:
With its characteristic black-and-yellow lines, this can
be used to designate loading zones for a handcar.

name: Handcar
description:
These carts clang along atop railway tracks. You can
even link a bunch of carts together!

name: Elevator platform
description:
You can make a functional elevator by using ladders
to vertically connect two elevator platforms.

name: Lift platform
description:
Place two of these with enough distance between
them to create an automatic transport system!

name: Cash register
description:
Place this on a table and power it on, and Pokémon
will come by to conduct trades!

name: Sprinkler
description:
An irrigation device that sprays water in a wide area.
Try putting one near the waterside!

name: Mini floodgate
description:
Turn the handle on top to start or stop the flow
of water!

name: Utility pole
description:
Use these to connect electrical generators to
machines and send electricity over long distances.

name: Wireless power-transmitter switch
description:
Connect these to electrical generators and use them
to easily turn things on and off.

name: Wireless power transmitter
description:
Use these to connect electrical generators to
machines and send electricity over long distances.

name: Mini generator
description: Place this anywhere, and it will generate electricity all on its own. What a remarkable machine!

name: Floor switch
description: A ground-mounted switch that activates nearby machinery when it detects weight.

name: Wall switch
description:
A switch that would look perfect installed on a house
wall. Press it to activate nearby devices!

name: Card reader
description: A machine that reads key cards or Pokédexes. Mount it to a wall.

name: Laser sensor
description:
When this sensor detects movement, it activates
devices nearby.

name: Security camera
description:
A camera that watches over its surroundings.
Place one anywhere you want to keep an eye on!

name: Mushroom streetlight
description:
Darkness poses no problem when you’ve got a
gentle mushroom glow.

name: Town streetlight
description:
Power this with electricity to illuminate the area with
gentle light.

name: Harbor streetlight
description:
A streetlight that invokes harbor vibes. The life buoy
stands out as the main highlight.

name: Chic streetlight
description:
When powered on, this light emits a gentle glow that
faintly illuminates its surroundings.

name: Double streetlight
description:
When powered on, both lamps shine brightly to
illuminate their surroundings.

name: Mushroom lamp
description:
The mushroom emits a gentle glow, illuminating the
surroundings with soft light.

name: Plain lamp
description:
Powering this on illuminates the surroundings with
warm light.

name: Desk light
description: A light with a simple design. Perfect for brightening up your desk when you need to focus on work.

name: Poké Ball light
description:
A neon light that glows red and white when powered
on. It would look great on top of a table.

name: Berry table lamp
description: A Rawst Berry made of glass. Power it on to illuminate the area with pale blue light.

name: Cute lamp
description:
A cute decorative lamp, even when it’s turned off.
Power it on to make the central heart glow.

name: Poké Ball lamp
description:
Emits a brilliant light when powered on. This would
look great on a shelf.

name: Model planet
description:
A model of some unexplored, faraway planet. It looks
just like a piece of yummy candy...

name: Red meteor lamp
description:
When powered on, this sparkles like a shooting star
and instantly gives its surroundings a mystical vibe.

name: Orange meteor lamp

and instantly gives its surroundings a mystical vibe.

name: Luxury lamp
description: When this lamp is powered on, it emits a gentle light, illuminating its surroundings.

name: Garden light
description:
A light that’s perfect for a garden. Beautifully
illuminates flowers—even at night!

name: Lantern
description:
This emits bright light when powered on. You’ll feel
safe if you have this, even in a dark cave!

name: Seedot lamp
description:
When mounted to a wall, this looks just like a Seedot
hanging from a branch!

name: Mirror ball
description:
Sparkles and twinkles when powered on.
Quickly turns the whole area into a party zone.

name: Wall light
description:
A light that can be fixed to a wall. Power it on, and
it’ll light the area with a warm glow.

name: Shell lamp
description:
It looks like a simple seashell at first glance, but hang
it up and power it on, and it emits a gentle light.

name: Fluorescent light
description: Shines brilliantly when powered on. Even nighttime feels like noon when this light is on!

name: Gaming light
description:
Emits rainbow light when mounted to a wall and
powered on.

name: Resort light
description:
A light that resembles a ball of tangled string.
Its gentle glow creates a fancy atmosphere.

name: String lights
description:
Hang these lights on the wall and power them on to
create a lively atmosphere.

name: Pop art lamp
description:
The bright bulb bounces off a shiny lampshade.
Looking at it seems to improve your mood!

name: Berry hanging lamp
description:
When hung from the ceiling and powered on, the tip
of the Chesto Berry emits a gentle light.

name: Surface light
description:
Simple, inconspicuous lights. You can embed them in
ceilings and walls.

name: Spotlight
description:
When powered on, this light shines brightly on
whatever is in front of it.

name: Antique chandelier
description:
Hang this from the ceiling to illuminate a room with
gentle light. Perfect for a mansion aesthetic!

description:
Cooking equipment for making soup. Put this on a
stove or campfire.

name: Oil lantern
description:
A lantern that provides a dim glow when lit.
Perfect for exploring dark places!

name: Jirachi lamp
description:
A lamp with a sleeping Jirachi perched on top.
Perfect for placing by your bedside!

name: Standing frame
description: A frame with a stand you can place on the ground. Try displaying various things with it!

name: Blender
description:
Kitchen equipment for making smoothies. Grab some
ingredients and make something tasty!

name: Bubble machine
description: Creates bubbles when powered on. Try placing it near mud of underwater crops.

name: Wireless power-transmitter post
description:
Use these to connect electrical generators to
machines and send electricity over long distances.

name: Wireless power-transmitter switch post
description: Connect these to electrical generators and use them to easily turn things on and off.

name: Dangling streetlight
description:
The glass lights shine brightly when powered on,
illuminating the area with a beautiful light.

name: Pearl streetlight
description:
An elegant streetlight made with a pearl. It always
glows and doesn’t need electricity.

name: Lampion
description:
This lampion can even be used underwater.
Keeps its surroundings bright at all times.

name: Cursola light
description: Cursola's stomach lights up when powered on, showering the surroundings in a gentle glow.

name: Chain lamp
description: A lamp made to be suspended from the ceiling. Try attaching a chain to adjust its length.

Seeds that grow into beans. Try planting them in

Seeds that grow into tomatoes. Try planting them in
