Seeds that grow into wheat. Try planting them in
a field!

name: Potato seeds
description:
Seeds that grow into potatoes. Try planting them in
a field!

name: Tall grass
description:
Grass that smells faintly of soil. It looks perfect for
Pokémon to hide in.

name: Yellow tall grass
description:
Grass that often grows by the seaside. It has a bright,
tropical color.

name: Red tall grass
description:
Grass that grows far and wide, even on volcanoes or
tall mountains. Its tips are as red as lava.

name: Pink tall grass
description:
Grass that paints the surface of the skylands pink
with its vivid floral hue.

name: Green shoots
description:
Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong, no
matter how much you walk on them.

name: Yellow-green shoots
description:
Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong, no
matter how much you walk on them.

name: Verdant shoots
description:
Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong, no
matter how much you walk on them.

name: Blue-green shoots
description:
Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong, no
matter how much you walk on them.

name: Duckweed
description:
It floats gently on the water’s surface. Some Pokémon
probably love sitting on this.

name: Flowering duckweed
description:
Duckweed leaves float in the water and support
blooming flowers that are larger than them.

name: Dense vines
description:
Hardy, creeping vines that cling securely to things
that plants can’t grow in, like bricks and boulders.

name: Moss
description:
This plant can grow anywhere dim and damp—even
on boulders!

name: Fern
description:
An unusual plant that can even grow in coarse
volcanic ash or bumpy igneous boulders.

name: Leppa tree
description:
A tree that grows Leppa Berries. Berries that fall from
its branches are sure to grow back after a while.

name: Large palm tree
description:
A large tree that grows by the seaside. Its shape looks
just like an Exeggutor!

name: Pointy tree
description:
These pointy trees grow in all sorts of different
places. They look pretty prickly.

name: Wildflowers
description:
Beautiful flowers blooming on fresh dirt. Looking at
them seems to soothe the mind.

name: Seashore flowers
description:
The symbol of a port town. Looking at these seems
to refresh you.

name: Mountain flowers
description:
Flowers that bloom elegantly, even in rugged, rocky
environments. They are always sublimely beautiful.

name: Skyland flowers
description:
Puffy flowers often found at the skylands. Their
blossoms are cute and ethereal.

name: Beautiful flowers
description:
Gorgeous and extravagant flowers in full bloom.
Be wary of the thorns on their stems.

name: Cute flowers
description:
Cute flowers that bloom in port towns. They would
surely be a delightful gift to any Pokémon.

name: Elegant flowers
description:
Flowers that stand tall, even in rugged mountains.
Their majestic elegance fills your heart with resolve.

name: Robust flowers
description:
Flowers resolutely blooming toward the sky.
Looking at them seems to fill you with energy.

name: Adorable hedge
description:
A round hedge often seen in wide-open fields.
Cute flowers are blooming on it.

name: Healthy hedge
description:
A hedge that has grown tall in the sunshine. Looking
at it seems to fill you with vigor.

name: Damp hedge
description:
A hedge with lustrous flowers blooming on it. It might
be even more beautiful on a rainy day.

name: Stylish hedge
description:
With petals blooming one atop the other, this fluffy
hedge looks just like Mareep wool.

name: Square plant
description:
A bush that has grown thick, dense leaves. You can
make a hedge by joining a few of these together.

name: Leppa tree stump
description:
A stump left behind after cutting down a Leppa tree.
It looks like it would make a great seat.

name: Palm tree stump
description:
Sit on this stump, gaze out at the sea, and enjoy total
relaxation.

name: Pointy tree stump
description:
The remains of a felled pointy tree. The stump itself
is round and not pointy at all.

name: Driftwood
description:
The remains of a tree that washed ashore. It would
look great as a piece of interior decor.

name: Sticky web
description:
A web that clings to walls or rocks. If you get tangled
in it, you might have a hard time moving.

name: Large boulder
description:
A large, heavy boulder. Looks like even hardened
fists couldn’t break this.

name: Mossy boulder
description: The dense moss clinging to it can’t be peeled off...

name: Molten rock
description:
Lava that’s still cooling and hardening. Pour water on
it to instantly harden it.

name: Cooled molten rock
description:
Molten rock that has been cooled with water. Heat it
up again by placing it near lava!

name: Stalagmites
description:
Mineral formations that jut from the ground in
limestone caverns. They look like big Pokémon fangs!

name: Stalactites
description:
Dissolved limestone that has rehardened. These hang
from the ceilings of limestone caverns.

name: Icicles
description:
Formed when moisture on the ceiling freezes into ice.
Place these to cool the surrounding area.

name: Crystal cluster
description:
Gemstones that brightly sparkle in caves. Shatter one
and use the pieces to make something!

name: Strength rock
description:
Though this boulder is incredibly big, it looks like you
could use Strength to push it.

name: Dandy flower seeds
description: Seeds that blossom into dandy flowers once grown. Try planting them in some soil!

name: Dandy flowers
description: Fluffy yellow flowers that seem fine and dandy. They bloom in the sunlight.

name: Red crystal cluster
description: Striking, sparkling crystals found on Dream Islands. Sableye collects their broken fragments.

name: Seabed flower seeds
description:
Seeds that blossom into seabed flowers. Try planting
them on the ocean floor or in some soil!

name: Watermelon seeds
description:
Seeds that grow into watermelons. Try planting them
in a field!

name: Sea grape stalk
description:
Seaweed commonly found underwater. It produces
lots of tiny fruits.

name: Seabed tall grass
description: Grass that can grow underwater. It looks perfect for Pokémon to hide in.

name: Seabed shoots
description: Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong, no matter how much you walk on them.

name: Sea moss
description:
Pink moss that grows under the sea. It seems slightly
different from normal moss.

name: Lush seaweed
description:
Seaweed that grows rapidly underwater. It can be cut
down and eaten.

name: Seabed flowers
description:
Flowers whose soft blooms have a slight ephemeral
quality. They can be found swaying in the sea basin.

name: White driftwood
description: Driftwood that has been tossed by waves and bleached white by the sun.

name: Mossy ocean boulder
description:
The dense sea moss clinging to it can’t be
peeled off...

name: Chimney rocks
description:
Tall chimney-like rocks. When placed underwater,
bubbles float out of them.

name: Small coral
description:
A small piece of coral with a pretty gradient. It’s flat,
so it could be used as a table.

name: Tall coral
description:
Tall coral with branching arms. It’s pretty hard to
the touch.

name: Colorful corals
description:
A collection of several kinds of coral. Put them on
display to instantly add some color to a space!

name: Wooden steps
description:
If you build steps, it’ll be easier for Pokémon to walk
on sloping roads.

name: Stylish steps
description:
A stylish set of steps made of plaster and wood.
They’d look great alongside some plaster walls.

name: Stone steps
description:
Steps made of stacked stones. Place several of these
for a stately atmosphere.

name: Concrete steps
description:
A sturdy set of steps made of concrete. Try placing
them on paths or in buildings!

name: Brick steps
description:
Modern steps made of brick. Place lots of these to
create a stylish town!

name: Iron steps
description:
Steps that wouldn’t look out of place in a factory.
They’re a bit bumpy, which helps prevent slipping.

name: Wooden ladder
description:
Linking these vertically makes climbing even the
highest of walls a breeze!

name: Iron ladder
description:
Great for reaching high places. Connect them
vertically, then climb straight up.

name: Wire
description:
A wire that can support objects of any weight.
It’s perfect for hanging furnishings from the ceiling!

name: Metal chain
description: A thin, sturdy chain. Link a few pieces together, and you can use them to climb up to high places!

name: Rope
description:
A length of thick, sturdy rope. Tie a few together and
climb it to reach high places!

name: Pulley
description:
A pulley that hangs from the ceiling. This works great
for hanging ropes or decorations!

name: Rustic door
description:
A door reinforced by large crossbeams. It’s perfect for
huts or ships.

name: Simple door
description:
A simple door with a glass window. It would look
great on a hut or warehouse.

name: Boat door
description:
An affluent-looking door with a number plate.
Perfect for guest rooms on a luxury cruise ship.

name: Modern door
description:
A simple yet sturdy door that would make the perfect
entrance to a house.

name: Stylish door
description:
A door made of glass from top to bottom. It seems
like it would fit well in modern-style rooms.

name: Brainy door
description:
A door with a practical, utilitarian design. Its colors
and the shape of its window are both very sleek.

name: Iron door
description:
A door with an antique pattern carved onto it.
Would pair well with gorgeous furniture.

name: Large wooden door
description:
A wooden door with a knob that makes it easy to
open and close, even for Pokémon!

name: Automatic doors
description:
You can’t open or close these as is, but they function
automatically when hooked up to electricity.

name: Shutter
description: It has a Poké Ball design smack-dab in the middle and feels like it could be the entrance to a secret base.

name: Wooden gate
description:
This would make a great building entrance—and also
work as part of a wooden fence.

name: Swinging doors
description: Café-style double doors. Place them at an entryway and watch Pokémon come and go!

name: Iron gate
description: Fancy double doors with a whirling pattern. It would pair nicely with some metal fencing.

name: Simple curtain (left)
description: Plain, simple curtains that work well with any room.

name: Simple curtain (right)
description: Plain, simple curtains that work well with any room.

name: Hatch window
description: A window with a heavy hatch that can be opened and closed. It's perfect for houses.

name: Underground hatch
description:
A window with a heavy hatch that opens and closes.
Place it on the ground to make an underground door.

name: Glass window
description:
A simple window that fits in any space. Arrange
multiple vertically or horizontally—your call!

name: Window pane
description:
A framed glass pane. It makes a great window or
partition.

name: Stained-glass window (upper)
description:
A fancy stained-glass window. It’s got a slightly
retro vibe.

name: Stained-glass window (middle)
description:
A fancy stained-glass window. It’s got a slightly
retro vibe.

name: Stained-glass window (lower)
description:
A fancy stained-glass window. It’s got a slightly
retro vibe.

name: Sash window
description:
A long, vertical window with a cute cross trim. Try
opening up the bottom half!

name: Sloped tiled roof
description: You can arrange these vertically or horizontally to make a roof.

name: Tiled hipped roof
description: Try using this when you make a roof! It looks like it would fit beautifully along the edges.

name: Tiled roof valley
description: When you're planning out the shape of your roof, putting in some valleys adds a really nice touch.

name: Flat tiled roof
description: If you make your roof a little flatter, it'll look nice and stylish!

name: Tiled roof decoration
description: Try putting this on a roof! It looks great whether you install one or a whole bunch!

name: Magikarp decoration
description: This would be a great accent piece in the center of a roof.

name: Stone hipped roof
description: Try using this when you make a roof! It looks like it would fit beautifully along the edges.

name: Sloped stone roof
description:
You can arrange these vertically or horizontally to
make a roof.

name: Skylight
description:
This would be a great accent piece in the center of
a roof.

name: Stone roof valley
description: When you're planning out the shape of your roof, putting in some valleys adds a really nice touch.

name: Flat stone roof
description: If you make your roof a little flatter, it'll look nice and stylish!

name: Stone roof decoration

name: Despot Fossil (head)

A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s head. Its large fangs

name: Despot Fossil (body)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s body. Its sharp claws

name: Despot Fossil (legs)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s legs. Two stocky legs
support the rest of its body.

name: Despot Fossil (tail)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s tail. Even the very
tip is spiky like its frill.

name: Tundra Fossil (head)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s head. It has sails that
resemble an aurora.

name: Tundra Fossil (body)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s body. It must have
been pretty tall with a spine like this!

name: Tundra Fossil (tail)
description:
A fossil of an ancient Pokémon’s tail. The tip is curled
up and looks like a spring.
